debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r r-u-n-d the b-i-d-r-i-g-g-i-n-g s-c-h-e-m-e and d-r-a-f-t-e-d the r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n l-e-t-t-e-r s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e a-u-d-i-t
2) the a-c-t-o-r l-o-g-g-e-d the h-i-d-d-e-n p-a-y-m-e-n-t t-r-a-c-k and s-a-v-e-d the o-f-f-b-o-o-k l-e-d-g-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k
3) the a-c-t-o-r e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d the p-r-i-c-i-n-g d-a-t-a a-m-o-n-g the c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s and c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d the s-h-a-r-e-d s-h-e-e-t-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t r-e-v-i-e-w
4) the a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d the c-o-v-e-r b-i-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s to m-i-m-i-c the c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n and a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the s-t-a-g-g-e-d s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
5) the a-c-t-o-r c-l-o-s-e-d the m-a-t-t-e-r as c-o-n-s-o-l-i-d-a-t-e-d and s-e-a-l-e-d the e-x-h-i-b-i-t f-o-l-d-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-c-c n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
